text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after a heavy downpour, out on the 
training track—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
On my way here, I took a huge tumble right 
into a puddle...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuu! And here I got all pumped up so the 
rain wouldn't get to me, too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems an unexpected stroke of bad luck 
has dampened their precious motivation...
